title: Neon Pulse — Episode 67: Coordinates of Doom
description: Kael follows Marcus's coordinates to a derelict orbital platform, only to discover an automated countdown targeting the city below.
character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves

scenes.narration: The encrypted coordinates led me straight to an abandoned orbital platform hovering above the clouds. The air here was thin, freezing, and charged with static electricity.
scenes.visual: Wide cinematic shot of a ruined futuristic metal platform floating above a dense sea of grey clouds at sunset low angle dramatic lighting

scenes.narration: Marcus didn't just escape the blast. He left these glowing beacons deliberately, daring me to follow him into the lion's den.
scenes.visual: Close up of a pulsing neon blue metallic device resting on cracked concrete floor casting harsh shadows across dark surroundings

scenes.narration: Suddenly, automated security turrets dropped from the ceiling, their targeting lasers locking instantly onto my chest.
scenes.visual: Rapid action shot of robotic chrome turrets descending from a metallic ceiling with bright red laser sights pointing forward

scenes.narration: I threw up my hands, channeling the amber energy from my jacket to deflect the barrage of plasma fire.
scenes.visual: Medium action shot of a person raising both hands forward creating a shimmering orange energy shield that blocks glowing blue projectile blasts

scenes.narration: The blast wave shattered the observation window, sucking me out toward the howling void of the upper atmosphere.
scenes.visual: Dramatic low angle shot of massive glass panes breaking inward with flying debris and rushing wind against a dark stormy sky

scenes.narration: Using my remaining energy, I launched myself back onto the metal decking, gasping for breath as sirens wailed.
scenes.visual: Close up profile of a man kneeling on grated metal flooring catching his breath with smoke swirling around his boots

scenes.narration: Before me, the main console flared to life, displaying a live countdown timer pointing directly at the metropolis below.
scenes.visual: Medium shot of a massive curved holographic display glowing red with digital numbers ticking down rapidly above a dark control desk

scenes.narration: If you want to see how this high-stakes battle unfolds and help me stop the countdown, follow along for more.
scenes.visual: Cinematic portrait shot looking determinedly past the camera lens with bright amber sparks floating softly in the dark background air
